clips.title: 乌克兰无人机猛攻 俄罗斯炼油能力骤降20-30% 全国燃油短缺

subtitles.en: All right. This past week, Ukraine sent a record number of drones targeting Russian oil refineries.
subtitles.zh: 上周，乌克兰派出创纪录数量的无人机袭击俄罗斯炼油厂。

subtitles.en: At least 194 drones were downed over Moscow with some drones reaching the key Moscow refinery that supplies road fuel to the capital.
subtitles.zh: 至少194架无人机在莫斯科上空被击落，部分无人机抵达向首都供应道路燃料的关键莫斯科炼油厂。

subtitles.en: Ukraine has stepped up drone attacks in an effort to bring the Kremlin into negotiating for the peace.
subtitles.zh: 乌克兰加大无人机攻击力度，试图迫使克里姆林宫进行和平谈判。
zh_highlights: 迫使克里姆林宫进行和平谈判
en_highlights: bring the Kremlin into negotiating for the peace

subtitles.en: Sorry. Bring the Kremlin to the table to negotiate for peace. And as drone attacks are becoming more frequent, Russia is also having trouble with its oil output.
subtitles.zh: 抱歉，是迫使克里姆林宫坐到谈判桌前。随着无人机攻击愈发频繁，俄罗斯的石油产量也出现问题。
zh_highlights: 迫使克里姆林宫坐到谈判桌前

subtitles.en: On June 11, OPEC published a report noting that in May, Russia was 690,000 barrels a day below the country's required level of crude output under agreement with OPEC and its
subtitles.zh: 6月11日，欧佩克发布报告称，5月份俄罗斯的原油日产量比其与欧佩克及其盟友协议要求的水平低69万桶。

subtitles.en: allies. For more on Russia, Andrew Kramer, joined by Bloomberg News, senior writer Stephanie Baker.
subtitles.zh: 更多关于俄罗斯的报道，由彭博新闻社资深撰稿人斯蒂芬妮·贝克与安德鲁·克莱默共同呈现。
zh_highlights: 彭博新闻社资深撰稿人

subtitles.en: She's also the author of the book, Punishing Putin Inside the Global Economic War, to bring down Russia.
subtitles.zh: 她也是《惩罚普京：全球经济战内幕》一书的作者，旨在击垮俄罗斯。
en_highlights: Punishing Putin Inside the Global Economic War

subtitles.en: Stephanie, great to see you. Great to speak with you. And I guess I should start with kind of the broad question here, which is how dire straits are there?
subtitles.zh: 斯蒂芬妮，很高兴见到你。我想我应该从一个宽泛的问题开始：俄罗斯目前的能源获取和不断上涨的价格有多严峻？

subtitles.en: Are they in Russia right now when it comes to energy access to energy and these escalating prices?
subtitles.zh: 俄罗斯目前面临大范围的燃料短缺。

subtitles.en: Well, there are widespread fuel shortages across Russia.
subtitles.zh: 俄罗斯各地普遍出现燃料短缺。

subtitles.en: More than 50 regions are reporting fuel shortages.
subtitles.zh: 超过50个地区报告燃料短缺。

subtitles.en: And in Crimea, Russian occupied Crimea, they just suspended fuel sales to civilians.
subtitles.zh: 在俄占克里米亚，他们暂停向平民出售燃料。

subtitles.en: They're sequestering fuel supplies for the military, which I think is a significant step.
subtitles.zh: 他们为军队预留燃料，我认为这是重要一步。
en_highlights: sequestering fuel supplies for the military

subtitles.en: This is all the result of what Ukrainian President Vladimir Zelensky calls the long-range sanctions
subtitles.zh: 这一切都是乌克兰总统泽连斯基所称的对俄远程制裁的结果。
